title: questions.jsonl line
description: One typed question per line of .standards/questions.jsonl. Written by `scripts/questions.mjs ask`, or by hand. Each reviewer comment gets two questions: label and severity. A comment is a convention when its label answer is not none.

id.description: The review_id, a #, then the topic, such as forge:123456#label.

review_id.description: The id of the reviews.jsonl record this question is about.

topic.description: label asks which convention the comment enforces, or none. severity asks how much harm ignoring it causes.

kind.description: choice picks one of options. score picks a position on ordered levels.

prompt.description: The question, phrased so it reads the same to any answerer.

state.description: Everything the answerer judges: the comment body, its file path, and its diff hunk or commit diff when present.

options.description: For choice questions: every label id from .standards/labels.json, plus none.

option_descriptions.description: For choice questions: each option mapped to what it means. Label options carry their description from labels.json, so an answerer can tell the labels apart without reading that file.

level_descriptions.description: For score questions: each level mapped to the situation it describes, so levels mean the same thing to every answerer.

levels.description: For score questions: the ordered levels, lowest first. Severity uses nit, minor, major, blocker.
